WITH RECURSIVE eclate(theme, reste) AS (
    SELECT '', q6_freins_codes || ';'
      FROM reponses
     WHERE q6_freins_codes IS NOT NULL AND q6_freins_codes <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT substr(reste, 1, instr(reste, ';') - 1),
           substr(reste, instr(reste, ';') + 1)
      FROM eclate
     WHERE reste <> ''
)
SELECT e.theme AS frein,
       COUNT(*) AS mentions,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reponses WHERE q6_freins_codes IS NOT NULL AND q6_freins_codes <> ''), 1) AS part_pct
  FROM eclate e
 WHERE e.theme <> ''
 GROUP BY e.theme
 ORDER BY mentions DESC
